title: Hold a permit for facilities producing scheduled chemicals
what: Operating a facility that produces, processes or uses certain scheduled chemicals needs a permit.

sources.title: Chemical Weapons (Prohibition) Act 1994
sources.quote: 16 When is a permit required? (1) The operator of a facility requires a permit under this subsection to operate the facility during a particular year if Schedule 1 chemicals (other than excluded Schedule 1 chemicals) are likely to be produced, acquired, retained or used at, or transferred from, the facility during the year.
